newsitem.title: USA: Ecuador's new crude prices disappoint some lifters.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's new crude prices disappoint some lifters.

text.p: The new prices for crude oil set by Ecuador's state-owned oil company Petroecuador are expected to lead to some contract cancellations, according to lifters.

The new Petroecuador administration which came in after Ecuador's government was deposed earlier this year, recently changed the benchmark for pricing the country's Oriente crude from West Texas Sour/Midland (WTS) to West Texas Intermediate/Cushing (WTI) for those shipping to the Gulf and East Coasts of the U.S., a move that should have translated into a discount of $6.00 under WTI.
